documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported financial performance for the fiscal year 2025-26, achieving operating income of Rs. 1,58,563.68 Lakhs and a Profit After Tax of Rs. 24,446.00 Lakhs. The management highlighted robust EBITDA margins of 29% and a sustained PAT margin of 15%, driven by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB. During the year, the company advanced its infrastructure and technology investments, including the inauguration of a ₹120 Crore Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block and approval for a new 300-bed Paediatric Hospital.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that global healthcare demand continues to rise driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations.
demand_outlook.quote: As global healthcare demand continues to rise—driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations—healthcare providers are under mounting pressure to develop cutting-edge hospitals, clinics, and medical campuses within tighter budgets and accelerated timelines.

demand_outlook.claim: The Medical College experienced substantial growth with high demand for admission leading to all seats being filled.
demand_outlook.quote: The Medical College has experienced significant growth over the past years, with a substantial increase in patient intake. Their reputation has become so esteemed that there is now high demand for admission to this prestigious medical school, with all seats being filled.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved the construction of a 300-bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises, with work expected to commence in the second quarter of 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block was inaugurated, representing a capital investment of ₹120 Crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Representing a capital investment of ₹120 Crore, this state-of-the-art facility operates as a vertical hub of medical excellence.

capex_expansion.claim: The hospital launched Tamil Nadu’s first Varian ETHOS AI-powered Adaptive Radiation Therapy system as part of a ₹47 Crore investment in advanced oncology and diagnostics.
capex_expansion.quote: We launched Tamil Nadu’s first Varian ETHOS AI-powered Adaptive Radiation Therapy system, part of a ₹47 Crore investment in advanced oncology and diagnostics and continue to lead the state in performing CAR-T cell therapies.

capex_expansion.claim: The hospital will add another 100 beds in the main campus.
capex_expansion.quote: Our Hospital is a 2000 bed hospital. We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.

capex_expansion.claim: The OP block in Chennai will be ready for operation by this year end.
capex_expansion.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

capex_expansion.claim: The company inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch with added cath lab and MRI facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch of Kovai Medical Center now have added cath lab and MRI facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: Total investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounted to 5239.02 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to ` 5239.02 Lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: The hospital posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29% alongside a sustained PAT margin of 15% for the year 2025-26.
margins_costs.quote: Your hospital has posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29%, which is excellent compared to the current industry standards, and has shown a sustained PAT (Profit After Tax) margin of 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The profit margin for the year was 15%.
The company saves approximately 31% on its annual power bill through solar and wind power generation.
margins_costs.quote: This practice has enabled your company to save approximately 31% on the annual power bill.

margins_costs.claim: Biogas produced from decomposed biodegradable food waste results in reduced LPG costs for the hospital canteen.
margins_costs.quote: This initiative not only effectively manages waste but also results in reduced LPG costs, contributing to both environmental sustainability and cost savings.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of ₹15/- per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹15/- per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26 subject to the approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: Investment in medical equipment during the year 2025-26 amounted to Rs. 11,845.14 Lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2025-26 amounts to Rs. 11,845.14 Lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has recommended a 100% dividend.
The dividend on equity shares, if approved, would involve a cash outflow of 1094.23 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend on equity shares, if approved by the members would involve a cash outflow of ` 1094.23 lakhs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless integration of advanced technologies, and the need for uninterrupted, round-the-clock operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges, including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless integration of advanced technologies, and the need for uninterrupted, round-the-clock operations.

management_commitments.claim: Construction work for the 300-bed Paediatric Hospital may commence during the second quarter of 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the OP block will be ready for operation by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

management_commitments.claim: Dr. Nalla G Palaniswami was re-appointed as Managing Director for a period of five years effective from 1st October, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: consent of the company be and is hereby accorded to the appointment of Dr. Nalla G Palaniswami(DIN: 00013536) as Managing Director of the Company for the period of five years with effect from 1st October, 2024

management_commitments.claim: Mrs. V. Bhuvaneshwari was re-appointed as an Independent Non-Executive Director for a second term of five consecutive years effective from 3rd September, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: re-appointed as an Independent Non-Executive Director of the Company to hold office for a second term of five consecutive years with effect from 3rd September, 2024

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Vasanth Kumar Venkatasamy was appointed as an Independent Director for a term of 5 consecutive years from 1st September, 2024 upto 31st August, 2029.
management_commitments.quote: be and is hereby appointed as an Independent Director of the Company, to hold office for a term of 5 (five) consecutive years, from 1st September, 2024 upto 31st August, 2029.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. V. Sakthivel was appointed as Cost Auditor to conduct the audit of cost records for the financial year 2024-25.
management_commitments.quote: appointed by the Board of Directors of the company on recommendation of Audit Committee to Conduct the Audit of cost records of the Company for the financial year 2024-25 on a remuneration of ` 5,50,000/-

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
